fifa_association_name: multiple (labels absent from the official register)
statement: For each of the 112 labels assessed under policy P3: the label has no entry in FIFA's official member register (2018 report, editorial deadline 31 December 2018, which records affiliation years including first admissions), no admission/expulsion/resignation record was found in any examined source, no entry exists in the 2002 official legacy-site snapshot, FIFA's membership count was 211 in both 2018 and 2024 with no admission found after 13 May 2016 (Kosovo/Gibraltar), and the label is therefore determined by project policy to be a non-FIFA-member throughout the 1980-2024 research window.
limitations: Policy-based determination (user-authorized this conversation), not per-window FIFA rosters: the register does not preserve pre-2018 expulsion spells, so the theoretical admission-then-expulsion case is excluded only by the absence of any such record in examined sources; the exception channel (FIFA archives) reopens any individual case. These labels had no prior suggestions - nothing is replaced.

fifa_association_name: multiple (49th FIFA Congress admissions, inference applied by policy P2-ext)
statement: POLICY APPLICATION (P2-ext): for the seven former-Soviet republics whose applications were postponed on 3 July 1992 and for which the 49th Congress (16 June 1994) admitted 'seven former-Soviet republics', the congress date 16 June 1994 is used as the admission-date anchor for match dispositions (before: non-member; from: member), explicitly flagged as a cross-source inference with per-country FIFA records still missing.
limitations: The identification of the seven rests on the UPI postponement list + AP dispatch, not a FIFA enumeration; per-country admission records remain the outstanding FIFA primary gap for these teams.

fifa_association_name: Ceskoslovensky fotbalovy svaz (successor seat: Czech Republic, register 'Czech Republic 1907/1994')
statement: FIFA's official register records the Czech Republic's affiliation years as 1907/1994 - the 1907 first admission belongs to the Czechoslovak FA and the register shows no gap between it and the 1994 re-registration of the successor seat. The Czechoslovak FA's FIFA membership therefore spanned the whole 1980-01-27 to 1993-11-17 target-match window.
limitations: Year-level official anchor plus register continuity; the exact end of the Czechoslovak spell is not day-dated, but all target matches precede the 1994 re-registration and there is no documented gap.

fifa_association_name: Fudbalski savez Jugoslavije (successor seat: Serbia, register 'Serbia 1923')
statement: FIFA's official register records Serbia's affiliation year as 1923 - the year the Yugoslav FA was admitted - with no later re-admission year, i.e. the register treats the Yugoslavia/FR Yugoslavia/Serbia and Montenegro/Serbia seat as continuously affiliated since 1923. The Yugoslavia label's target matches (1980-03-22 to 1992-03-25) fall inside this continuous spell; the 1992-1994 competition ban is a suspension from competitions, not membership termination (production policy).
limitations: Year-level official anchor; the register's single 1923 year encodes the succession chain but the individual renamings are documented only by secondary sources; result/identity inheritance is explicitly NOT asserted - only the seat's affiliation continuity.

fifa_association_name: Federacion Futbol Korsou (Netherlands Antilles succession; register 'Curacao 1932')
statement: FIFA's official register records Curacao's affiliation year as 1932 with no interruption notation - the register treats the Netherlands Antilles/Curacao seat as continuously affiliated since 1932. The Curacao label's target matches (1980-09-12 to 2010-10-31) fall inside this continuous spell.
limitations: Year-level official anchor; the Netherlands Antilles dissolution (2010) and the seat's renaming are documented only by secondary sources; entity-identity caveats as AGB6-C004.

fifa_association_name: Russian Football Union (seat record 'Russia 1912/1992'; USSR period)
statement: FIFA's official register records Russia's affiliation years as 1912/1992 - a single seat first affiliated in 1912 and re-affiliated in 1992, implying the seat was occupied by the USSR association between its (commonly recorded) 1946 admission and 1991. The register does not name the USSR spell, and no official document obtained in this programme evidences the USSR admission year or the CIS transition; the 99 target matches before 3 July 1992 therefore remain unresolved pending succession evidence.
limitations: Official anchor exists for the seat's 1912/1992 structure but not for the USSR spell; the no-blanket-merge production policy forbids treating the USSR team as the Russia team without explicit succession evidence.
